channel.title: Crypto Market Dispatch
channel.description: Daily crypto reporting on liquidity, trading infrastructure, stablecoins and protocol economics, tracing market developments to their impact on builders.

item.title: How Collateral Ratios Turn Deposits Into Borrowing Power
item.description: Collateral ratios turn asset values into credit limits, while liquidation thresholds decide how much price volatility a borrower can survive.

item.title: Liquidity Bootstrapping Pools Turn Buyers Into Seed Capital
item.description: Liquidity bootstrapping pools draw reserve assets through a falling price curve, but buyers—not outside LPs—carry the new token’s market risk.

item.title: How Ethereum Rollups Turn Transactions Into Batches
item.description: Ethereum rollups compress many user transactions into one batch, then publish data and a state commitment to cut costs while preserving verification.

item.title: Arbitrage Keeps Crypto Prices Together—At a Cost
item.description: Arbitrageurs close crypto price gaps, paying gas and taking execution risk while liquidity providers earn the fees that make each correction possible.

item.title: Large Files Gain a Reproducible IPFS Root
item.description: A new IPFS profile standardizes how large files become verified trees, improving cross-tool retrieval while leaving persistence to paid storage providers.

item.title: Token Decimals Change Screens, Not Onchain Balances
item.description: Token decimals tell wallets how to scale integer balances; mistakes can misstate holdings, distort quotes and break minimum-size checks without moving funds.

item.title: What SPV Proofs Let Bitcoin Wallets Verify
item.description: SPV proofs let light wallets verify transaction inclusion and chain work, but not full block validity, fee logic or the absence of hidden transactions.

item.title: How Transaction Nonces Make Signed Orders Single-Use
item.description: Nonces make signed transactions single-use, but chain IDs and smarter nonce lanes are needed to prevent cross-chain replays without blocking parallel execution.

item.title: Pons Pushes Robinhood Chain Fees to $6M Record
item.description: Robinhood Chain hit $6 million in daily fees as Pons-led token trading lifted weekly DEX volume to $12.4 billion, concentrating risk and revenue.

item.title: Tether, Fasanara Anchor StableFund With $400 Million
item.description: Tether and Fasanara launched an evergreen credit fund anchored by $400 million, putting USDT settlement rails behind short-duration loans to global SMEs.

item.title: Cari’s $32.5 Million Bank Round Funds a Deposit Rail
item.description: Cari’s bank-only raise funds a tokenized-deposit rail whose instant user transfers still rely on deferred interbank settlement and undisclosed fees.

item.title: Visa Connects Onchain Credit to Card Settlement
item.description: Visa is using settlement data to automate receivables-backed loans for stablecoin card issuers, cutting idle capital without eliminating credit risk.

item.title: Block Seeks Federal Charter for Builders Bank
item.description: Block's proposed trust bank would put crypto custody under federal oversight, but it would neither insure assets nor supply markets with deposits or credit.

item.title: SoFi and Payward Gain the Route While Customers Pay
item.description: SoFi gains another crypto route and Payward gains bank settlement, but retail users still pay up to 1.90% while keeping little control over execution.

item.title: Bybit Halves TradFi RPI Rebates as Taker Access Widens
item.description: Bybit is halving its TradFi RPI maker rebate while opening protected liquidity to limit IOC and FOK orders, shifting value from makers to takers.
